title: Publish final reviewed NixOS source to Heim-PC main
goal: After T004 and T007 are terminal and independently reviewed, publish the exact ancestry-preserving final NixOS source lineage to heimgewebe/heim-pc through one separately leased fixed remote branch and one protected pull request. T008 must preserve exact T007—and transitively T006, T005, T001 and T002—as Git ancestors, incorporate every legitimate fresh Heim-PC main advance without rewriting that lineage, pass exact-head validation and review, and use Captain with merge_method=merge so canonical main contains the reviewed implementation history. After merge, T008 independently reads back the actual main commit/tree and creates the content-addressed published-source artifact that becomes T003's sole declarative/reconstruction source. This task changes repository source truth only; it performs no NixOS activation, storage mutation or production cutover.

approval.note: This task is the sole source-publication stage for the migration. It may use only the Bureau-recorded run-scoped worktree, the exclusive repo.heim-pc claim, the separately leased fixed branch repo:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc:branch:nixos-migration-v1-final-publication, the immutable T007 rehearsal-source artifact and the published-source artifact path. Any merge into main remains a separate Captain high-impact action with exact PR/head/base/diff/CI/review evidence and merge_method=merge; this TaskSpec alone grants no main-merge authority. It grants no NixOS activation, storage, EFI, firmware, reboot or production-cutover authority.

acceptance.assertion: T008 begins only after T004 and T007 are terminal and independently reviewed. Evidence binds the exact T004 activation-proof result plus exact T007 final integration commit/tree and rehearsal-source artifact manifest/digest, exact T006 and T005 predecessor commits and proven transitive T001/T002 ancestry. Independent re-hash plus Git-object readback must agree; any failed activation proof, missing commit object, artifact mismatch or broken ancestry fails closed before publication mutation.

Before any publication mutation, the run holds the exclusive repo.heim-pc claim materialized as repo:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc plus immutable rehearsal-source read and published-source write leases. No other migration task is authorized to publish the final source lineage to a remote branch or main; missing, foreign, expired or drifting lease state fails closed.

Before Git/index/tree mutation, the execution envelope contains the exact Bureau run-scoped workspace identity. Its frozen baseline is the canonical architecture commit b0c1745b077dcdc0bea0381cbf2dc247994e5dc9, and all integration/reconciliation work occurs only in that workspace. A reused fixed worktree, dirty preimage, branch mismatch or missing workspace record fails closed.

Immediately before final publication integration, remote Heim-PC main is freshly observed and must contain canonical architecture commit b0c1745b077dcdc0bea0381cbf2dc247994e5dc9 as an ancestor. Inside the run-scoped workspace, exact T007 and exact fresh main are combined using ancestry-preserving Git merge operations so the publication head is a descendant of both. Legitimate intervening main work is retained; conflicts or semantic overlap require explicit review, and rebase/squash/cherry-pick substitution that rewrites T007 ancestry is forbidden.

Before push and again before merge, Git ancestry readback proves the publication head contains exact T007 as an ancestor, T007 contains exact T006 and T005, and T006 contains exact T001 and T002. The reviewed publication tree contains the T007 artifact source plus all legitimate fresh-main changes and no unexplained delta. Tree equivalence without this commit-lineage proof is insufficient.

Before the first git push, the run holds the exact live Grabowski lease repo:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc:branch:nixos-migration-v1-final-publication under the same task/run owner binding. Only the exact reviewed publication head may be pushed to that fixed branch; lease loss, remote-head drift, another owner or any alternate branch target fails closed before another push.

The fixed publication branch is exposed only through one open protected pull request to heimgewebe/heim-pc main. PR base/head, fresh base SHA, changed paths and canonical GitHub diff are bound to the exact reviewed publication head, and the diff preserves T007 lineage plus only explicitly reviewed fresh-main conflict resolutions. Head/base drift invalidates earlier review and merge evidence.

Required Heim-PC validate, guard and smoke checks plus all applicable security checks are green on the exact PR head; a revision-bound independent review and complete canonical diff review have no unresolved material findings. Any head change requires full rebinding before merge.

The main-branch effect is dispatched only through Captain as one target-bound pr-merge action for the exact Heim-PC PR/head/base/diff with merge_method explicitly set to merge. Repository rules, required checks, review settlement, fresh status projection, execution intent, merge leases and human/execution authorization must all pass immediately before effect. Squash, rebase, direct push to main, force-push and branch deletion are outside authority.

After Captain reports success, GitHub and Git readback prove the PR merged from the exact reviewed head, current main contains the resulting merge commit, and exact T007, T006, T005, T001 and T002 terminal commits are all ancestors of current main. The merged source tree retains the reviewed T007 implementation together with legitimate intervening main work.

Only after the protected merge and exact post-merge lineage readback, T008 independently reads the actual current main commit/tree and, while holding artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source exclusively for write, creates a content-addressed whole-source artifact from that repository-authoritative tree. Its immutable manifest binds pre-merge main, reviewed publication head/tree, actual merge commit/tree, T007 ancestry, archive/content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity; immediate independent re-hash proves the artifact exactly equals merged main. This artifact—not T007's pre-publication tree—is T003's sole declarative/reconstruction source.

Only after post-merge ancestry proof and published-source artifact readback, typed Bureau workspace-status/cleanup preflights may classify terminal T001/T002/T005/T006/T007/T008 implementation branches as contained by remote main. Cleanup remains a separate typed lifecycle effect and must not force-remove dirty, foreign, ambiguous or otherwise ineligible workspaces; immutable migration artifacts required by T003 remain retained.

T008 performs repository integration/publication only. It executes no NixOS build activation on the productive host, no sgdisk, wipefs, cryptsetup luksFormat, mkfs, EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, productive nixos-install, productive switch or reboot into a new production OS, and grants no production device or cutover authority.
